telemetry.method: For each date, sum each of the six camera-stage mean tokens per completed request, then add cross-camera mean tokens per model call multiplied by cross-camera calls divided by the Montrose-shoreline completed-request reference index. Average daily rows within each period.

cache_evidence.note: Cached input is a subset of input and is not added to total tokens.

incremental_readout_since_2026_09_22.interpretation: The estimated reduction weakened by 0.299 percentage points as September 22-23 were added. September 23 cross-camera call rate was 29/33=0.879, so deterministic quiet synthesis was used less often that day. No additional efficiency gain is claimed.

limitations: Request-normalized estimate is not coverage-normalized dollar savings; request counts are not deduplicated cycle counts.
The top-level summary lacks a missing_records field; absence is not zero missingness.
Historical daily valid-cycle completeness has not been reconstructed.
No Jubilee event occurred in the audited post period, so equivalent event-detection effectiveness, misses and false alerts are not established.
Provider billing/tier rates remain unreconciled and dollar savings remain unpriced.
decision: Retain the deployed runtime with rollback. The extended evidence supports a modest roughly 7.7% token reduction, not the 50% target and not proven equivalent event effectiveness. Do not change camera coverage or alert behavior.
